human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Dogfood must distinguish 'no violation found' from 'this governance dimension was actually evaluated'. Add a small deterministic coverage read model for existing dimensions such as authority, approval, budget, validation and scope using only normalized evidence. The first version should expose evaluated, unknown, or not_applicable states and must not introduce a synthetic risk score.
human_pressure.why_now: Real EverRun dogfood can otherwise make an empty signal set look cleaner than the evidence justifies, even though current operations documentation explicitly warns that no signals does not prove every control was evaluated.
do_not_misread: Coverage is evidence completeness/assessment status, not a security score.
Coverage must not guess intent or infer a control was evaluated because the run succeeded.
Not-applicable requires positive evidence or deterministic contract semantics; absence alone defaults to unknown.
red_lines: No numeric governance or risk score.
Do not redefine existing governed_outcome semantics in this pack unless required only to expose coverage alongside it.

machine_core.goal: Project deterministic governance coverage per run so operators can see which governance dimensions were evaluated, unknown, or explicitly not applicable.
red_lines: No synthetic score or weighted risk model.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Coverage is derived only from normalized evidence and existing projection facts.
Absence of required evidence remains unknown unless an explicit not-applicable fact exists.
Existing signal generation remains independently inspectable.
Coverage is rebuildable from immutable evidence.

producer.artifact: ExecutionProjection governance records and normalized validation/scope evidence

consumer.component: run report and governed-outcome read model consumers

observable_effect.assertion: A run report can distinguish evaluated, unknown and not-applicable governance dimensions without inferring missing evidence as clean.

proofs.assertion: Focused projection/report tests prove coverage states for present, absent and explicitly not-applicable evidence.

failure_semantics: Missing evidence maps to unknown unless explicit deterministic evidence supports not_applicable.
Conflicting evidence does not resolve to evaluated-clean; it remains unknown/reviewable according to existing projection semantics.
Coverage does not override native outcome or existing governed outcome.

forbidden_complexity: new database tables unless proven necessary

steps.title: Define minimal coverage states
details: Introduce a compact enum/model for evaluated, unknown and not_applicable coverage.
Keep dimension names limited to governance evidence that already exists in the projection model.

steps.title: Derive coverage from evidence
details: Derive authority, approval, budget, validation and scope coverage deterministically from existing records and facts.
Do not use run success, signal absence or source identity as evidence that a dimension was evaluated.

steps.title: Expose coverage in reports
details: Add coverage to the deterministic run report without removing native outcome, governed outcome or signals.
Keep backward compatibility where practical and document any output-shape change in tests.

steps.title: Prove unknown semantics
details: Add focused cases for absent evidence, present evaluated evidence, and explicit not-applicable evidence where the current contract supports it.
Reject tests that equate no signals with complete governance coverage.

acceptance: Run reports expose coverage for existing governance dimensions.
Missing evidence is represented as unknown, not evaluated-clean.
No numeric score or LLM-derived governance fact is introduced.
Existing native and governed outcomes remain separately visible and deterministic.
Coverage is rebuildable from stored evidence.

must_check: Dependency is satisfied: 8048.normalize-external-evidence-projection makes package-derived evidence projectable on the production path.
Coverage derives only from evidence already available to Ailuros.
Unknown remains distinct from evaluated and not_applicable.
No synthetic risk score is introduced.
reject_if: No signals is treated as proof that all governance dimensions were evaluated.
Run success is used to infer authority, approval or budget coverage.
A numeric score, LLM evaluator or policy DSL is added.
Unknown is treated as clean or approved.
A new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path is introduced for non-capability reasons.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Focused governed-outcome and execution-report tests protect the read-model boundary, followed by full-suite validation.
